question: In November 2024, India and Singapore conducted a joint military exercise named Agni Warrior 2024. Where was this exercise held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Devlali, Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The joint military exercise "**Agni Warrior 2024**" was conducted between **India and Singapore** in** November 2024**.
 
• The exercise was held at the **Devlali Field Firing Ranges** in Maharashtra, India.
 
• Agni Warrior is a **bilateral artillery exercise** aimed at enhancing interoperability and sharing expertise between the two nations’ armed forces.
 
• The exercise involves training on advanced artillery systems, simulation exercises, and live firing drills.
 
• It is part of the ongoing defense cooperation and **long-standing strategic partnership** between India and Singapore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Devlali Field Firing Ranges**

 
 
• Located in Maharashtra, India, Devlali is one of the oldest military centers in India, established by the British in 1861.
 
• It is a key location for artillery training and testing due to its expansive area and infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **India-Singapore Defense Relations**
 
 
• India and Singapore have a strong defense partnership, with regular joint exercises in all three domains: army, navy, and air force.
 
• Key exercises include SIMBEX (navy), Bold Kurukshetra (army), and Joint Staff Talks.
 
 
 
• **Artillery Modernization in India**
 
 
• India has been modernizing its artillery systems with platforms like the K9 Vajra, M777 Howitzer, and Dhanush.
 
• These advancements aim to enhance India’s long-range precision strike capabilities.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Joint Military Exercises**
 
 
• Joint exercises like Agni Warrior improve mutual trust and understanding between countries.
 
• They also enhance operational readiness and technical expertise in handling modern weapon systems.
